name: cue-strike-soft
prompt: Gentle leather cue tip tap on a phenolic pool ball, soft click with faint wooden cue resonance, close mic in a quiet pool hall

name: cue-strike-hard
prompt: Sharp powerful cue stick strike on a pool ball, loud crisp leather tip crack with punchy attack, billiard hall acoustics

name: ball-click-soft
prompt: Two pool balls lightly touching, soft delicate ivory clack, short and gentle, close mic

name: ball-click-medium
prompt: Two billiard balls colliding at moderate speed, bright clean resin clack, crisp pool hall acoustics

name: ball-click-hard
prompt: Hard fast collision of two phenolic pool balls, loud sharp percussive clack with a slight snap echo

name: cushion-thump-soft
prompt: Pool ball gently bumping a rubber table cushion, soft low padded thud with muted felt contact

name: cushion-thump-hard
prompt: Pool ball slamming into a rubber cushion rail, deep firm thump with a brief felt vibration

name: pocket-drop
prompt: Pool ball dropping into a leather pocket, hollow knock followed by the ball rattling down and settling inside

name: foul-buzz
prompt: Short low referee penalty buzzer, dull descending electronic buzz, subdued game show error tone

name: ui-click
prompt: Small neat wooden button click, dry percussive tick, minimal clean interface sound

name: ui-confirm
prompt: Soft positive confirmation tap, two quick gentle wooden knocks, friendly menu select sound

name: turn-chime
prompt: Two soft ascending mallet chime notes announcing a turn change, warm glockenspiel ding, calm and clear

name: hint-beep
prompt: Single gentle high bell ping used as a hint cue, soft rounded glass-like tone

name: win-fanfare
prompt: Short upbeat victory flourish, four rising bright mallet notes ending on a sparkling chime, warm triumphant celebration

name: lose-fanfare
prompt: Brief gentle defeat motif, three soft descending marimba notes fading out, sympathetic and quiet

name: rack-setup
prompt: Fifteen billiard balls settling into a wooden triangle rack on cloth, a rapid cluster of soft resin clacks then quiet, close mic in a pool hall

name: cue-place
prompt: A single pool ball set down gently onto felt cloth by hand, one soft muted tap with a faint fabric brush, close mic

name: groups-set
prompt: Two quick decisive wooden knocks of a knuckle on a polished pool table rail, dry and short, quiet pool hall

name: undo-rewind
prompt: Soft short reversed swish, a gentle quick backwards whoosh with a faint rising tone, subtle interface undo sound

name: achievement-sparkle
prompt: Bright short glockenspiel arpeggio of four quick rising notes with a soft shimmering sparkle tail, rewarding unlock jingle, warm and clear

name: hall-ambience
prompt: Quiet room tone of an intimate pool hall late at night, faint air conditioning hum, very distant low murmur of two or three patrons, one far-away ball click, steady and calm, no music
